items.zh: 我订了大床房，现在能办入住吗？
items.scene: 下午三点拖着行李箱走到前台

answers.en: Hi, I have a king room booked — can I check in now?
answers.note: 最常用的到店说法，先报订单再问能不能办，语气平和，适合普通前台。

answers.en: I'm here to check in. I booked a king room.
answers.note: 先说来意再补订单，句子短而干脆，适合前台正忙、后面有人排队时。

answers.en: I've got a reservation for a king room — is it ready?
answers.note: I've got 比 I have 更口语，问 is it ready 是关心房间收好没有，适合早到。

items.zh: 我航班晚点，半夜才能到，房间给我留着啊。
items.scene: 航班延误，在机场打给酒店前台

answers.en: My flight's delayed and I won't get in until midnight — please hold my room.
answers.note: 直接说明情况和请求，please hold my room 是明确的保留要求，适合打给前台。

answers.en: I'm stuck at the airport. Can you make sure my room isn't given away?
answers.note: 强调担心房间被放出去，语气更急，适合已经晚了很多、怕订单被取消时。

answers.en: Just a heads-up — I'll be checking in around midnight because of a delayed flight.
answers.note: heads-up 是提前打个招呼，语气轻松客气，适合只想通知一声、不要求特别处理。

items.zh: 房间还没好，行李能先放你们这儿吗？
items.scene: 中午提前到店，房间还在打扫

answers.en: My room isn't ready yet — could you hold my bags for a bit?
answers.note: could you 客气，hold my bags 是酒店寄存的常用说法，适合跟前台说。

answers.en: Can I leave my luggage here while I go grab lunch?
answers.note: leave my luggage 更直白，顺带说明去干嘛，适合随口一问、不想太正式。

answers.en: Any chance you could stash my bags until the room's ready?
answers.note: stash 偏随意，Any chance 带试探，适合年轻前台、气氛比较轻松时。

items.zh: 我明早七点退房，赶得上早餐吗？
items.scene: 睡前到前台问第二天的安排

answers.en: I'm checking out at seven tomorrow — will I make it for breakfast?
answers.note: make it for breakfast 是赶得上的口语说法，整句轻松，适合睡前问前台。

answers.en: Does breakfast start early enough if I check out at seven?
answers.note: 从早餐开始时间问起，逻辑清楚，适合想确认具体时刻、和前台不熟时。

answers.en: I have a seven a.m. checkout tomorrow. Is breakfast before that?
answers.note: 拆成两句，信息清楚，适合前台英语一般、需要说慢一点的时候。

items.zh: 退房能延到下午两点吗？我火车是四点的。
items.scene: 早上打电话跟前台商量晚点退房

answers.en: Could I get a late checkout — say, two o'clock? My train's at four.
answers.note: late checkout 是酒店标准说法，say 让时间像在商量，适合电话沟通。

answers.en: Is there any way to keep the room until two? My train doesn't leave till four.
answers.note: Is there any way 更恳切，像在求通融，适合前一晚房间紧张、没把握时。

answers.en: I'd like to stay in the room till two tomorrow — is that okay?
answers.note: 直接讲需求再问行不行，语气平实，适合当面在前台说、不必绕弯。

items.zh: 房卡放前台就行吧？我叫的车到了。
items.scene: 早上拖着箱子赶网约车

answers.en: I'll just leave the key card at the front desk — my ride's here.
answers.note: just 表示图省事，顺带说明车到了，适合赶时间、想快点脱身。

answers.en: Can I drop the key card off at the desk on my way out?
answers.note: drop off 是顺路交还，用问句更礼貌，适合前台有人排队时。

answers.en: Key card's on the counter — thanks, I'm heading out!
answers.note: 极简口语，像边走边喊，只适合和前台已经打过照面、气氛随意时。

items.zh: 我订的这间没有窗户啊，还有带窗的吗？
items.scene: 刷卡进房发现房间没有窗

answers.en: This room doesn't have a window — do you have any with one?
answers.note: 先指出问题再问有没有，语气中性，适合刚进门发现、还没拆行李时。

answers.en: I booked this room expecting a window. Is there another one available?
answers.note: expecting a window 暗示预期落空，比直接抱怨稳，适合准备提出换房。

answers.en: Sorry, is there any chance of a room with a window? This one's a bit closed in.
answers.note: Sorry 开头缓和，closed in 形容闷，语气软，适合不想把关系搞僵。

items.zh: 两张床的房间和大床房差多少钱？
items.scene: 和同事出差，在前台确认房型

answers.en: How much more is a king room than a room with two beds?
answers.note: 用 room with two beds 把房型说全，不容易搞混，适合当面问价。

answers.en: Is there a price difference between the two-bed room and the king?
answers.note: the two-bed room 更简，问法平稳，适合前台已经介绍过两种房型之后。

answers.en: What's the upcharge for a king instead of two beds?
answers.note: upcharge 指加价，商务口吻，适合要报销、想把费用问清楚时。

items.zh: 加钱能换成江景房吗？
items.scene: 办入住时问前台房间朝向

answers.en: Could I upgrade to a river-view room? I don't mind paying extra.
answers.note: upgrade 指升级房型，主动说愿意加钱，礼貌又清楚，适合办入住时。

answers.en: How much to switch to a room with a river view?
answers.note: How much to... 省掉主语，口语省事，适合快速问个价。

answers.en: Any river-view rooms left? I'll pay the difference.
answers.note: 先问有没有再表态补差价，节奏快，适合旺季房间紧张时。

items.zh: 早餐几点开始？在几楼吃？
items.scene: 办入住时顺口问一句前台

answers.en: What time does breakfast start, and where is it?
answers.note: 一句问两件事，最省事，适合办入住时顺口问。

answers.en: When's breakfast, and which floor?
answers.note: When's 是 When is 的缩写，很口语，适合前台忙、想快点问完。

answers.en: Could you tell me the breakfast hours and the floor?
answers.note: hours 指供应时段，说法完整客气，适合第一次住、想记清楚。

items.zh: 早餐能送到房间吗？孩子还没醒。
items.scene: 带着三岁孩子住店，打前台电话

answers.en: Can breakfast be delivered to my room? My kid's still asleep.
answers.note: 被动句更客气，说明原因，适合打电话到前台。

answers.en: Do you do room service for breakfast? I've got a sleeping kid here.
answers.note: room service 指送餐服务，Do you do 很口语，适合先问有没有这项服务。

answers.en: Could I get breakfast sent up? The little one's napping.
answers.note: sent up 是送上楼，little one 指孩子，语气轻松，适合和服务员闲聊式沟通。

items.zh: 押金多少？什么时候退回来？
items.scene: 前台让刷预授权的时候问一句

answers.en: How much is the deposit, and when do I get it back?
answers.note: get it back 是最直白的退还说法，两个问题一起问，适合办入住时。

answers.en: What's the hold on my card, and when does it clear?
answers.note: hold 指预授权冻结，clear 指解冻，偏银行说法，适合用信用卡时。

answers.en: How big a deposit do you need? And how long does the refund take?
answers.note: refund 偏书面，问的是退款周期，适合要算预算或准备报销时。

items.zh: 押金能扫码付吗？我没带银行卡。
items.scene: 办入住掏手机准备付款

answers.en: Can I pay the deposit with WeChat Pay? I left my card at home.
answers.note: 直接点名微信支付，说明原因，最清楚，适合前台拿不准时。

answers.en: Can I pay the deposit on my phone?
answers.note: on my phone 泛指手机付款，不点名某个 App，适合前台拿不准、想留余地时。

answers.en: Is it okay if I just scan to pay the deposit?
answers.note: scan to pay 是扫码付，just 显得随意，适合年轻前台、气氛轻松时。

items.zh: 隔壁吵得睡不着，能给我换个房间吗？
items.scene: 晚上十一点被隔壁电视声吵醒

answers.en: The room next door is really loud — could I switch rooms?
answers.note: switch rooms 是换房常用说法，先讲问题再提要求，适合夜里打前台电话。

answers.en: I can't sleep with all that noise next door. Is there another room I could move to?
answers.note: 把睡不着放在前面，情绪更明显，适合噪音持续很久、想被重视时。

answers.en: Sorry to bother you, but the neighbors are pretty loud. Any chance I could change rooms?
answers.note: Sorry to bother you 先缓和，Any chance 带试探，适合不想兴师问罪。

items.zh: 空调不制冷，能换一间吗？
items.scene: 夏天入住发现空调只出热风

answers.en: The AC isn't cooling — can I get a different room?
answers.note: AC 是空调的口语说法，直接提要求，适合打电话或下楼找前台。

answers.en: My air conditioner isn't working. Could someone take a look, or move me to another room?
answers.note: 先要求检修再提换房，给对方选择，适合不想一上来就换房。

answers.en: The AC in my room is dead. I'd rather switch rooms than wait for a repair.
answers.note: dead 表示彻底坏了，I'd rather 表明态度，适合天热、等不了维修时。

items.zh: 能换到高一点的楼层吗？我怕吵。
items.scene: 办入住时嫌二楼临街不放心

answers.en: Could I move to a higher floor? I'm a light sleeper.
answers.note: light sleeper 指睡觉轻，说明原因，语气客气，适合办入住时提。

answers.en: Any chance of a room on a higher floor? Street noise keeps me up.
answers.note: Any chance 更委婉，keeps me up 说清困扰，适合房间还没定下来时。

answers.en: I'd prefer a higher floor if you have one — I'm worried about noise.
answers.note: I'd prefer 表达偏好而非要求，留有余地，适合前台说房型紧张时。

items.zh: 隔壁开派对到半夜，你们管不管？
items.scene: 凌晨一点打电话到前台投诉

answers.en: The people next door have been partying all night — can you do something about it?
answers.note: can you do something about it 是要求处理，带不满，适合凌晨打前台。

answers.en: There's a party next door and it's past midnight. Could you send someone up?
answers.note: send someone up 要求派人上去，具体可行，适合噪音已经影响整层。

answers.en: Sorry, but the room next door is having a party. Is there anything you can do?
answers.note: Sorry 开头、语气软，适合不想把火撒在前台身上时。

items.zh: 你们房间隔音怎么样？我睡觉特别轻。
items.scene: 订房前打电话问酒店隔音

answers.en: How soundproof are the rooms? I'm a really light sleeper.
answers.note: soundproof 直接问隔音，说明自己睡觉轻，适合订房前电话咨询。

answers.en: Are the rooms pretty quiet? Noise wakes me up easily.
answers.note: pretty quiet 更口语，不用专业词，适合和销售或前台随便聊。

answers.en: Do the walls block much noise? I need total quiet to sleep.
answers.note: block noise 指挡噪音，total quiet 强调要求高，适合准备订高层房时。

items.zh: 今天不用打扫，谢谢。
items.scene: 出门前跟走廊里的保洁阿姨说

answers.en: No need to clean today, thanks.
answers.note: 最短最直接，对保洁阿姨说刚好，语气不冷。

answers.en: We're all set in here — could you skip us today?
answers.note: skip us 是保洁圈里跳过这间的说法，语气轻松，适合短住、不想被打扰。

answers.en: Please don't disturb the room today — we're still sleeping.
answers.note: don't disturb 是请勿打扰的正式说法，说明原因，适合门上挂了牌还要口头交代。

items.zh: 能再送两条毛巾上来吗？
items.scene: 打电话给客房服务要东西

answers.en: Could you send up two more towels?
answers.note: send up 是送上来，酒店常用，简洁礼貌，适合打客房服务电话。

answers.en: We're short on towels up here — can we get two more?
answers.note: short on 是缺，说法轻松，适合语气不用太正式的场合。

answers.en: Two extra towels to room 806, please.
answers.note: 极简报需求加房号，像吩咐，适合忙时快速说完。

items.zh: 退房后行李能放你们这儿吗？我晚上的飞机。
items.scene: 早上退房，晚上才去机场

answers.en: Can I leave my bags here after checkout? My flight isn't till tonight.
answers.note: leave my bags 最常用，说明航班时间，适合退房时问前台。

answers.en: Do you have luggage storage? I check out this morning but fly out tonight.
answers.note: luggage storage 是行李寄存的正式说法，适合不确定酒店有没有这项服务。

answers.en: Could you hold my suitcase until this evening? I've got a late flight.
answers.note: hold my suitcase 更具体，late flight 口语，适合已经和前台聊过几句。

items.zh: 寄存的行李最晚几点取？
items.scene: 寄存时问前台最晚时间

answers.en: What's the latest I can pick up my bags?
answers.note: the latest I can 是问最晚时间的地道说法，简洁，适合寄存时问。

answers.en: Until what time can I leave my luggage with you?
answers.note: Until what time 从寄存时长问起，逻辑清楚，适合想一并确认能不能过夜。

answers.en: Is there a cut-off time for collecting stored luggage?
answers.note: cut-off time 是截止时间，说法偏正式，适合看告示或找经理确认。

items.zh: 我房间没热水，根本洗不了澡。
items.scene: 晚上十点打电话给前台报修

answers.en: There's no hot water in my room — I can't even take a shower.
answers.note: can't even 带抱怨，情绪明显，适合晚上急着洗澡时打前台。

answers.en: My room has no hot water. Could you send someone up to check?
answers.note: 先陈述再要求检修，语气克制，适合想解决问题而不是吵架。

answers.en: I'm stuck with cold water in my room. Any idea when it'll be fixed?
answers.note: stuck with 表示无奈，问修复时间，适合已经等了一阵、想知道进度。

items.zh: 这房间一股烟味，我订的是无烟房。
items.scene: 进房闻到烟味，下楼找前台

answers.en: This room smells like smoke, and I booked a nonsmoking room.
answers.note: smells like smoke 直说气味，点明订单，适合下楼找前台换房。

answers.en: I reserved a nonsmoking room, but mine reeks of cigarettes.
answers.note: reek of 表示味道很重，语气更强，适合房间烟味刺鼻时。

answers.en: Sorry, my room's supposed to be nonsmoking, but it smells pretty strongly of smoke.
answers.note: supposed to be 委婉指出不符，语气软，适合不想当场起冲突。

items.zh: 我订的是含早餐的，前台怎么说没有？
items.scene: 早上带孩子去餐厅被拦下

answers.en: My booking includes breakfast — why did the front desk say it doesn't?
answers.note: 直接引用前台说法反问，逻辑清楚，适合拿着订单去理论。

answers.en: I booked a rate with breakfast. Can you check my reservation?
answers.note: rate with breakfast 是含早房价，说法专业，适合请前台查系统。

answers.en: Breakfast should be included in my booking. Could you double-check?
answers.note: should be 留有余地，double-check 请对方再确认，适合不想把话说死。
